```{r}
extract_filename <- function(full_path) {
  # Extract the file name from the path
  filename <- basename(full_path)
  
  # Remove the file extension
  filename_sans_ext <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(filename)
  
  # Extract the date and sequence part using regex
  # This regex assumes the format is always ending with a sequence like "2024-11-21_001"
  desired_part <- sub(".*_([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}_[0-9]{3})$", "\\1", filename_sans_ext)
  
  return(desired_part)
}
```

```{r}
readAny<-function (ptr, con, offset, what, size)
{
  seek(con, where = ptr + offset)
  an<-readBin(con, what, size = size)
  return(an)
}
```

```{r}
readlabel<-function (ptr, con, offset = 4)
{
  seek(con, where = ptr + offset)
  lab<-readBin(con, "char")
  return(lab)
}
```

```{r}
add_atributes<-function (tree, con, verbose = F, filename, con_pgf = con,encoding=getOption("encoding"))
{
  bundletree.pgf <- read.bundletree(filename, ".pgf",
                                    con_pgf,encoding=encoding)
  for (rootname in names(tree)) {
    attr(tree[[c(rootname)]], "class") <- c("HEKA_treeinfo_rootnode",
                                            "HEKA_treeinfo")
    GRLabels <- lapply(tree[[c(rootname)]], function(item) {
      readlabel(attr(item, "dataptr"), con)
    })
    attr(tree[[c(rootname)]], "names") <- paste(1:length(tree[[c(rootname)]]),
                                                ":", GRLabels)
    for (exp in names(tree[[rootname]])) {
      attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp)]], "class") <- c("HEKA_treeinfo_experimentnode",
                                                   "HEKA_treeinfo")
      sernames <- lapply(tree[[c(rootname, exp)]], function(item) {
        readlabel(attr(item, "dataptr"), con)
      })
      attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp)]], "names") <- paste(1:length(tree[[c(rootname,
                                                                        exp)]]), ":", sernames)
      label <- readlabel(attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp)]],
                              "dataptr"), con)
      expnumber <- readAny(attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp)]],
                                "dataptr"), con, 116, "int", 4)
      if (!label == paste0("E-", expnumber)) {
        attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp)]], "ExperimentLabel") <- label
      }
      for (ser in names(tree[[c(rootname, exp)]])) {
        attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser)]], "class") <- c("HEKA_treeinfo_seriesnode",
                                                          "HEKA_treeinfo")
        attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser)]], "path") <- c(rootname,
                                                         exp, ser)
        sweeplabels = lapply(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser)]],
                             function(item) {
                               readlabel(attr(item, "dataptr"), con)
                             })
        attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser)]], "names") <- paste("s",
                                                              1:length(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser)]]), ":",
                                                              sweeplabels, sep = "")
        stimcount <- readAny(attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp,
                                          ser)]][[1]], "dataptr"), con, 40, "int",
                             2)
        StimName <- readAny(attr(bundletree.pgf[[stimcount]],
                                 "dataptr"), con_pgf, 4, "char",
                            NA)
        attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser)]], "StimulusName") <- StimName
        label = readlabel(attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp,
                                       ser)]], "dataptr"), con)
        if (!label == StimName) {
          attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser)]], "SeriesLabel") <- label
        }
        if (verbose) {
          for (sweep in names(tree[[c(rootname, exp,
                                      ser)]])) {
            attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser, sweep)]],
                 "path") <- c(rootname, exp, ser,
                              sweep)
            attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser, sweep)]],
                 "class") <- c("HEKA_treeinfo_sweepnode",
                               "HEKA_treeinfo")
            attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser, sweep)]],
                 "names") <- lapply(tree[[c(rootname,
                                            exp, ser, sweep)]], function(trace) {
                                              readlabel(attr(trace, "dataptr"),
                                                        con)
                                            })
            for (trace in names(tree[[c(rootname, exp,
                                        ser, sweep)]])) {
              attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser, sweep,
                           trace)]], "path") <- c(rootname,
                                                  exp, ser, sweep, trace)
              attr(tree[[c(rootname, exp, ser, sweep,
                           trace)]], "class") <- c("HEKA_treeinfo_tracenode",
                                                   "HEKA_treeinfo")
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  tree
}
```

```{r}
pm_load_nodes<-function (con, nlevels, lvl_sizes, level)
{
  stopifnot(level <= nlevels)
  size <- lvl_sizes[[level]]
  dataptr <- seek(con)
  seek(con, seek(con) + size)
  nchildren <- readBin(con, "int", size = 4)
  if (nchildren == 0) {
    node <- "trace"
    attr(node, "dataptr") <- dataptr
  }
  else {
    node <- lapply(1:nchildren, function(child) {
      pm_load_nodes(con, nlevels, lvl_sizes, level + 1)
    })
    attr(node, "dataptr") <- dataptr
  }
  node
}
```

```{r}
read.bundletree<-function (filename, bundlename = ".pul", con = NA,encoding=getOption("encoding"))
{
  name<-""
  rm(name)
  finally_close_con = is.na(con)
  if (is.na(con)) {
    con <- file(filename, "rb", encoding=encoding)
  }
  seek(con, 0)
  signature <- readChar(con, 8)
  if (signature == "DAT2") {
    seek(con, where = 48)
    nitems <- readBin(con, "int", size = 1)
    seek(con, where = 64)
    bundleitems <- do.call(rbind, (lapply(0:nitems, function(item) {
      start <- readBin(con, "int", size = 4)
      end <- readBin(con, "int", size = 4)
      name <- readChar(con, 8)
      data.frame(start = start, end = end, name = name,
                 stringsAsFactors = F)
    })))
    start <- subset(bundleitems, name == bundlename)$start
    seek(con, where = start)
  }
  else {
    start <- 0
  }
  seek(con, where = start)
  magic <- readChar(con, nchars = 4)
  stopifnot(magic == "eerT")
  nLevels <- readBin(con, "int", size = 4)
  lvl_sizes <- lapply(1:nLevels, function(i) {
    readBin(con, "int", size = 4)
  })
  tree <- pm_load_nodes(con, nLevels, lvl_sizes, 1)
  if (finally_close_con)
    close(con)
  tree
}
```

```{r}
get_treeinfo<-function (filename, slim = F,encoding=getOption("encoding"))
{
  con = file(filename, "rb")
  signature <- readChar(con, 4)
  if (!(signature == "DAT1" || signature == "DAT2"))
    stop("file type is not supported")
  if (signature == "DAT1") {
    mypul <- stringr::str_replace(filename, ".dat$",
                                  ".pul")
    if (!file.exists(mypul)) {
      close(con)
      stop("while trying to read from *.dat file, detected the old 'DAT1' format (no bundle file), therefore expected but could not find a correspoding *.pul file")
    }
    con_pul <- file(mypul, "rb")
    mypgf <- stringr::str_replace(filename, ".dat$",
                                  ".pgf")
    if (!file.exists(mypul)) {
      close(con)
      stop("while trying to read from *.dat file, detected the old 'DAT1' format (no bundle file), therefore expected but could not find a correspoding *.pgf file")
    }
    con_pgf <- file(mypgf, "rb")
  }
  else {
    con_pul = con
    con_pgf = con
  }
  treeinfo <- list(root = read.bundletree(filename, ".pul",
                                          con = con_pul,encoding=encoding))
  attr(treeinfo[["root"]], "filename") <- filename
  names(treeinfo) <- filename
  class(treeinfo) <- "HEKA_treeinfo"
  treeinfo <- add_atributes(treeinfo, con_pul, verbose = !slim,
                            filename = filename, con_pgf = con_pgf,encoding=encoding)
  if (signature == "DAT1") {
    close(con_pul)
    close(con_pgf)
  }
  close(con)
  treeinfo
}
```

```{r}
 process_series <- function(series_list) {
    all_spike_frequencies <- list()
    for (series_number in series_list) {
      data <- ImportPRecording(data_file, experiment_number, series_number, traces = 1)
      timepoints <- data@TimeTrace
      current_data_pA <- data@Data[["Imon-1"]] * 1e12
      colnames(current_data_pA) <- as.numeric(gsub("s|:", "", colnames(current_data_pA)))
      
      sweeps_data <- as.data.frame(current_data_pA) %>%
        mutate(Time = timepoints) %>%
        pivot_longer(-Time, names_to = "Sweep", values_to = "Current") %>%
        arrange(Sweep, Time) %>%
        group_by(Sweep) %>%
        group_modify(~ {
          time <- .x$Time
          current <- .x$Current
          dt <- mean(diff(time))
          Fs <- 1 / dt
          b_high <- signal::butter(2, 0.2 / (Fs / 2), type = "high")
          b_low <- signal::butter(4, 700 / (Fs / 2), type = "low")
          filtered <- signal::filtfilt(b_low, signal::filtfilt(b_high, current))
          derivative <- c(NA, diff(filtered) / dt)
          threshold <- max(derivative, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5
          spike_indices <- which(derivative > threshold)
          refractory_samples <- round(0.002 / dt)
          valid_spike_indices <- if (length(spike_indices) > 0) {
            idx <- spike_indices[1]
            for (i in spike_indices[-1]) {
              if (i - tail(idx, 1) > refractory_samples) idx <- c(idx, i)
            }
            idx
          } else integer(0)
          .x$Is_spike <- FALSE
          .x$Is_spike[valid_spike_indices] <- TRUE
          return(.x)
        }) %>% ungroup()

      spike_times <- sweeps_data %>%dplyr::filter(Is_spike) %>% select(Time, Sweep)
      bin_size <- 0.05
      bins <- seq(0, max(sweeps_data$Time, na.rm = TRUE) + bin_size, by = bin_size)
      spike_histogram <- hist(spike_times$Time, breaks = bins, plot = FALSE)
      spike_frequency <- (spike_histogram$counts * 20) / length(unique(sweeps_data$Sweep))
      spike_frequency_df <- data.frame(Bin_start_time = bins[-length(bins)], Spike_frequency = spike_frequency)
      all_spike_frequencies[[paste0("Series_", series_number)]] <- spike_frequency_df
    }
    return(all_spike_frequencies)
  }
```

```{r}
  process_series_vd <- function(series, response_type) {
    data <- ImportPRecording(data_file,
        experiment = experiment_number,
        series = series,
        traces = 1,
        encoding = getOption("encoding"),
        filetype = 'PatchMaster',
        verbose = TRUE
    )

    timepoints <- data@TimeTrace
    current_data_pA <- data@Data[["Imon-1"]] * 1e12
    colnames(current_data_pA) <- as.numeric(gsub("s|:", "", colnames(current_data_pA)))

    cutoff_high <- 0.2
    cutoff_low <- 700
    high_order <- 2
    low_order <- 4

    sweeps_data <- as.data.frame(current_data_pA) %>%
      mutate(Time = timepoints) %>%
      pivot_longer(-Time, names_to = "Sweep", values_to = "Current") %>%
      arrange(Sweep, Time) %>%
      group_by(Sweep) %>%
      group_modify(~ {
        time <- .x$Time
        current <- .x$Current
        dt <- mean(diff(time))
        Fs <- 1 / dt
        b_high <- signal::butter(high_order, cutoff_high / (Fs / 2), type = "high")
        b_low <- signal::butter(low_order, cutoff_low / (Fs / 2), type = "low")
        filtered <- signal::filtfilt(b_low, signal::filtfilt(b_high, current))
        derivative <- c(NA, diff(filtered) / dt)
        threshold <- max(derivative, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5
        spike_indices <- which(derivative > threshold)
        refractory_samples <- round(0.002 / dt)
        valid_spike_indices <- if (length(spike_indices) > 0) {
          idx <- spike_indices[1]
          for (i in spike_indices[-1]) {
            if (i - tail(idx, 1) > refractory_samples) {
              idx <- c(idx, i)
            }
          }
          idx
        } else integer(0)
        .x$Is_spike <- FALSE
        .x$Is_spike[valid_spike_indices] <- TRUE
        return(.x)
      }) %>%
      ungroup()

    bin_size <- 0.05
    bins <- seq(from = 2.0, to = 2.5, by = bin_size)
    filtered_data <- sweeps_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(Is_spike, Time >= 2.0 & Time < 2.5) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Bin = cut(Time, breaks = bins, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)) %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Sweep, Bin) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Frequency = Count / bin_size)

    average_frequencies <- filtered_data %>%
      dplyr::group_by(Sweep) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(AvgFrequency = mean(Frequency, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
      dplyr::mutate(Response = response_type)

    return(average_frequencies)
  }

```

```{r}
process_series_dsi <- function(series, response_type) {
  data <- ImportPRecording(
    data_file,
    experiment = experiment_number,
    series = series,
    traces = 1,
    encoding = getOption("encoding"),
    filetype = 'PatchMaster',
    verbose = TRUE
  )

  timepoints <- data@TimeTrace
  current_data_pA <- data@Data[["Imon-1"]] * 1e12
  colnames(current_data_pA) <- as.numeric(gsub("s|:", "", colnames(current_data_pA)))

  cutoff_high <- 0.2
  cutoff_low <- 700
  high_order <- 2
  low_order <- 4

  sweeps_data <- as.data.frame(current_data_pA) %>%
    mutate(Time = timepoints) %>%
    pivot_longer(-Time, names_to = "Sweep", values_to = "Current") %>%
    arrange(Sweep, Time) %>%
    group_by(Sweep) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      time <- .x$Time
      current <- .x$Current
      dt <- mean(diff(time))
      Fs <- 1 / dt
      b_high <- signal::butter(high_order, cutoff_high / (Fs / 2), type = "high")
      b_low <- signal::butter(low_order, cutoff_low / (Fs / 2), type = "low")
      filtered <- signal::filtfilt(b_low, signal::filtfilt(b_high, current))
      derivative <- c(NA, diff(filtered) / dt)
      threshold <- max(derivative, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5
      spike_indices <- which(derivative > threshold)
      refractory_samples <- round(0.002 / dt)
      valid_spike_indices <- if (length(spike_indices) > 0) {
        idx <- spike_indices[1]
        for (i in spike_indices[-1]) {
          if (i - tail(idx, 1) > refractory_samples) {
            idx <- c(idx, i)
          }
        }
        idx
      } else integer(0)
      .x$Is_spike <- FALSE
      .x$Is_spike[valid_spike_indices] <- TRUE
      return(.x)
    }) %>%
    ungroup()

  bin_size <- 0.05
  bins <- seq(from = 2.0, to = 3, by = bin_size)
  filtered_data <- sweeps_data %>%
    dplyr::filter(Is_spike, Time >= 2.0 & Time < 3) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Bin = cut(Time, breaks = bins, include.lowest = TRUE, right = FALSE)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Sweep, Bin) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(Count = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Frequency = Count / bin_size)

  average_frequencies <- filtered_data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(Sweep) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(AvgFrequency = mean(Frequency, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Response = response_type)

  return(average_frequencies)
}
```

```{r}
combine_frequencies <- function(frequencies, color) {
    bind_rows(frequencies) %>%
      group_by(Bin_start_time) %>%
      summarise(
        Average_Spike_Frequency = mean(Spike_frequency, na.rm = TRUE),
        SDSpikeFrequency = sd(Spike_frequency, na.rm = TRUE),
        SEMSpikeFrequency = SDSpikeFrequency / sqrt(n()),
        Condition = color,
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  }
```

```{r}
fires <- function(peak, baseline,
                  min_spike_hz = 1.0,
                  delta_over_baseline = 10.0) {
  if (is.na(peak) || is.na(baseline)) return(FALSE)
  peak >= max(min_spike_hz, baseline + delta_over_baseline)
}

```

```{r}
amp <- function(peak, baseline) {
  if (is.na(peak) || is.na(baseline)) return(NA_real_)
  max(0, peak - baseline)
}
```

```{r}
latency_to_response <- function(df,
                                t0 = 2,
                                baseline_window = c(0, 1),
                                k = 2,
                                consecutive_bins = 2) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  base_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Bin_start_time >= baseline_window[1],
                  Bin_start_time <  baseline_window[2])

  if (nrow(base_df) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  base_mean <- mean(base_df$Average_Spike_Frequency, na.rm = TRUE)
  base_sd   <- sd(base_df$Average_Spike_Frequency, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(base_mean)) return(NA_real_)
  if (!is.finite(base_sd)) base_sd <- 0

  thresh <- base_mean + k * base_sd

  post_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Bin_start_time >= t0) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(Bin_start_time) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(above = Average_Spike_Frequency > thresh)

  if (nrow(post_df) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  # Require N consecutive bins above threshold
  r <- rle(post_df$above)
  ends <- cumsum(r$lengths)
  starts <- ends - r$lengths + 1

  hit_idx <- which(r$values & r$lengths >= consecutive_bins)[1]
  if (is.na(hit_idx)) return(NA_real_)

  first_bin_index <- starts[hit_idx]
  latency_ms <- (post_df$Bin_start_time[first_bin_index] - t0) * 1000
  latency_ms
}

```

```{r}

get_mean_frequency <- function(df, window) {

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  values <- df %>%
    filter(
      Bin_start_time >= window[1],
      Bin_start_time <= window[2]
    ) %>%
    pull(Average_Spike_Frequency)

  if (length(values) == 0 || all(is.na(values))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  mean(values, na.rm = TRUE)
}

```

```{r}
get_peak_frequency <- function(df, window) {

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  values <- df %>%
    filter(
      Bin_start_time >= window[1],
      Bin_start_time <= window[2]
    ) %>%
    pull(Average_Spike_Frequency)

  if (length(values) == 0 || all(is.na(values))) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  max(values, na.rm = TRUE)
}

```

```{r}
get_fp_index <- function(baseline, peak, final) {

  if (
    is.na(baseline) ||
    is.na(peak) ||
    is.na(final) ||
    peak == baseline
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  (final - baseline) / (peak - baseline)
}
```
